about_the_game:
Manicos Haunted Hotel is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a haunted hotel which was built on an old burial ground during the 1950s.

Manicos hotel was built on an ancient burial ground during the 1950s. It was one of the best luxurious hotels which attracted tourists from all over the world. However, during the 1980s some of the tragic incidents took place in the hotel which marked the beginning of all of the paranormal activities. It was said that an old man shot himself to death in one of the hotel rooms on the third floor. His spirits were often seen by the hotel staff members and the tourists who stayed there. During the 1990s, a woman was stabbed to death by her husband in one of the rooms on the fourth floor. Her spirit is often seen in the hotel premises even to this day.

But recently, the paranormal activities in the hotel has gone worse to the point that the business started to lose customers. It has become a haunted attraction for the paranormal enthusiasts and investigators. It is believed by many paranormal investigators that the increase in the paranormal activity is due to the fact that the hotel was built on an old burial ground and that the tragic incidents just made it worse. The hotel stuff are scared to enter the basement area after one of them got scratched by a demon.

Colton, a paranormal enthusiast and one of the closest friends of the owner of the Manicos hotel, received a special invitation to investigate the hotel for one night in order to experience the paranormal.

You play as Colton, a paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the entire hotel for experiencing the paranormal. Will you be able to escape the haunted hotel safely?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire haunted hotel!
  • Beware of Evil spirits and Ghost Mirrors!
  • Collect items like keys, baseball bat, Golden Rings etc.
  • Avoid traps like rotating blades, knives etc.
  • Explore the spirit world!
  • Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation!
